headlines.title: AT&T and AST SpaceMobile: Engineering the Connected World, One Handoff at a Time
headlines.summary: DALLAS & MIDLAND, Texas, November 02, 2026--AT&T and AST SpaceMobile, with supporting ground-based technology from Ericsson and Nokia, have achieved what we believe is the industry’s first successful handoff between a ground-based cellular network and a direct-to-device satellite network.

headlines.title: AST SpaceMobile (ASTS) Completes First Ground To Satellite Cellular Handoff
headlines.summary: AST SpaceMobile (NasdaqGS:ASTS) and AT&T report the first successful handoff between ground cellular and direct-to-device satellite service. The live test transferred an active voice call from a land network to AST SpaceMobile's satellite connection and back again. Both companies describe the trial as a key step toward offering continuous mobile coverage to standard smartphones across wider geographies.

headlines.title: ASTS Stock Climbs From 16-Month Low: Boost Mobile Founder Urges AST To ‘Pivot FAST’ As SpaceX Eyes Bigger Wireless Push
headlines.summary: Jim Cramer saw competitive benefits in a potential Boost deal, while Tim Farrar suggested that SpaceX wanted DISH’s infrastructure.

headlines.title: ASTS Stock Dives 11% As SpaceX Reportedly Eyes EchoStar’s Boost Mobile
headlines.summary: According to a report from The Washington Post, SpaceX discussed a deal with EchoStar about its wireless carrier Boost Mobile.

headlines.title: AST SpaceMobile Sinks 10% as SpaceX Rises 2% on Reported Talks to Buy Boost Mobile
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysAST SpaceMobile fell 10% today on a report that SpaceX is in talks to buy EchoStar’s Boost Mobile. Boost would let SpaceX sell phone service directly, against AT&T and Verizon, AST’s US carrier partners.

description: AT&T Inc. provides telecommunications and technology services worldwide. It operates through two segments, Communications and Latin America. The Communications segment offers wireless voice and data communications services; and sells handsets, wireless data cards, wireless computing devices, carrying cases/protective covers, and wireless chargers through its own company-owned stores, agents, and third-party retail stores. It also provides AT&T Dedicated Internet, fiber ethernet and broadband, fixed wireless, and hosted and managed professional services; and copper-based voice and data, Virtual Private Networks (VPN), wholesale, outsourcing, and IP, as well as customer premises equipment for multinational corporations, small and mid-sized businesses, governmental, and wholesale customers. In addition, this segment offers broadband services, including fiber connections, legacy telephony voice communication services, and other VoIP services and equipment to residential customers. This segment markets its communications services and products under the AT&T, AT&T Business, Cricket, AT&T PREPAID, AT&T Fiber, and AT&T Internet Air brand names. Its Latin America segment provides postpaid and prepaid wireless services in Mexico under the AT&T and Unefon brand names, as well as sells smartphones through its stores, agents and third-party retail stores. The company was formerly known as SBC Communications Inc. and changed its name to AT&T Inc. in 2005. AT&T Inc. was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Dallas, Texas.
